source: Settings the design-rule checks need beyond design-rules.json. Every length the checks use comes from design-rules.json; this file only names things in the master copy.

sink_kinds.source: Owner, 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-07 (DECISIONS "Rough layout"): a sink dropped near a window centres under it, and a sink in front of a window but off centre gets a notice. The bar sink is not centred under windows in the rough layout, so it is not listed. Also the island sink of PREF-013.

back_wall_range_kinds.source: PREF-013 as the owner worded it (2026-10-05, confirmed 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-09): "an island sink and a back-wall range". A wall cooktop is not listed, because the rule names a range.

countertop_run_kinds.source: PROPOSED (2026-11-09, not owner-decided): the cabinet runs that carry a countertop, so their walkway is measured from the countertop edge (owner, 2026-11-09). Every run with base cabinets except all pantry and upper only.
